pr.title: Refactor account lookup
pr.body: lookup(connection, name): return only rows whose name exactly equals the untrusted input; users has columns id and name.

base_files.module.py:
def lookup(connection, name):
    return connection.execute('SELECT id FROM users WHERE name = ?', (name,)).fetchall()

changed_files.patch:
--- a/module.py
+++ b/module.py
@@ -1,2 +1,4 @@
 def lookup(connection, name):
-    return connection.execute('SELECT id FROM users WHERE name = ?', (name,)).fetchall()
+    query = 'SELECT id FROM users WHERE name = ?'
+    cursor = connection.execute(query, (name,))
+    return cursor.fetchall()

findings.description: The refactored code introduces an unnecessary variable 'query' which does not enhance readability or functionality. The original implementation was more concise.

decisions.rationale: Style criticism of the query variable is retained under policy; no actionable introduced defect.

normalization_notes: Reviewed final JSON, submitted body and inline comments together. Merged the same allegation across channels; retained all distinct defect allegations.
